source_name: ACCC quarterly/weekly monitoring and AIP regional diesel table
source_locator: low: June quarter 2025 five-largest-city average; central: regional weekly average 19 July 2026; high: regional daily average 25 March 2026
implementation_rule: Use central as the 2026 nominal base and low/high as stress anchors; report source dates explicitly
notes: Do not call the range a single-year statistical confidence interval; unusual 2026 volatility is intentionally retained
